answer.text: BPC‑157 significantly prevented liver necrosis, fatty changes, and histopathological damage in rat models of bile duct+hepatic artery ligation, restraint stress, CCl₄ administration, and lower‑extremity ischemia‑reperfusion injury, reducing biochemical markers of liver injury and oxidative stress [1][2]
